records.localization_note: Keep Rafael Castor and the captain name substitution. Julio and Claudio address the player through the native field.
Keep Janus Pasar. His discussion of a lost telescope supplies no different rank or title.
Keep Claudio Manaus in headings and his familiar Clau nickname in Rafael's and Arcadius's replies.
Keep Julio Erneco. Cristina's grandfather is a family relationship expressed by the dialogue.
Keep Arcadius Eudoxios in the public nameplate and Eirene in the separate catalogue field. The asides support the distinction.
Keep Yukihisa Shiraki in the nameplate and Genjo in the separate catalogue field. Rafael recognizes Yukihisa for his tip.
Keep Emilio Ferog. Rafael repeats Emilio's given name when quoting the invitation to eat.
Keep Charles Rochefort in the nameplate and Jean in the separate catalogue field. His scientific speech needs no professional title.
Keep Samwell Khan in the nameplate and da in the separate catalogue field. Rafael recognizes the familiar rumor pitch.
Keep Hans Letzel. His years of research are stated in dialogue without giving him an office.
Port Worker suits the dock attendant who identifies amber and passes along a local rumor.
Senior Monk preserves the source's senior religious role without assigning the monk a personal name or specific office.
Villager identifies the person entrusting the inherited lamp and does not presume a denomination.
Sect Leader fits the founder or leader who claims a revelation and gives orders to the group.
Follower reads naturally for the believer who answers the Sect Leader's calls.
